```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
senic <- read.csv("SENIC-P1.csv")
set.seed(36473)
idx <- sample(nrow(senic), 85)
mydata <- senic[sort(idx), ]
holdout <- senic[-idx, ]

library(tidyverse)
```


# II

```{r}
infection.model <- lm(length ~ infection, data = mydata)
census.model <- lm(length ~ census, data = mydata)
xray.model <- lm(length ~ xray, data = mydata)
facility.model <- lm(length ~ facility, data = mydata)
```

Note: Probably a much better way to do this so if you can clean it up feel free to change the code
```{r}

max(mydata$census)
```

## Distribution of length

```{r}
ggplot(mydata, aes(x = length)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") + labs(
    title = "Frequency of Length of Stay", x = "Length", y = "Frequency"
  )
```
## Outliers of hospital length

```{r}
outliers <- boxplot(mydata$length, plot = FALSE)$out
boxplot(mydata$length)
id.outliers <- mydata$id[mydata$length %in% outliers]
id.outliers
```

# III

### Intercept and Slope of Models

```{r}
b0.infection <- coef(infection.model)[1]
b1.infection <- coef(infection.model)[2]
b0.census <- coef(census.model)[1]
b1.census <- coef(census.model)[2]
b0.xray <- coef(xray.model)[1]
b1.xray <- coef(xray.model)[2]
b0.facility <- coef(facility.model)[1]
b1.facility <- coef(facility.model)[2]
b0.infection
b1.infection
b0.census
b1.census
b0.xray
b1.xray
b0.facility
b1.facility
```

### MSE and R^2

```{r}
MSE.infection <- mean(infection.model$residuals^2)
MSE.infection
MSE.census <- mean(census.model$residuals^2)
MSE.census
MSE.xray <- mean(xray.model$residuals^2)
MSE.xray
MSE.facility <- mean(facility.model$residuals^2)
MSE.facility

infection.r.squared <- summary(infection.model)$r.squared
census.r.squared <- summary(census.model)$r.squared
xray.r.squared <- summary(xray.model)$r.squared
facility.r.squared <- summary(facility.model)$r.squared
infection.r.squared
census.r.squared
xray.r.squared
facility.r.squared
```

### Plots with regression line

```{r}
ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = infection, y = length)) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.infection, slope = b1.infection, lwd = 1, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Length of Stay vs Infection", x = "Infection", y = "Length of Stay")

ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = census, y = length)) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.census, slope = b1.census, lwd = 1, color ="firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Length of Stay vs Census", x = "Census", y = "Length of Stay")

ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = xray, y = length)) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.xray, slope = b1.xray, lwd = 1, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Length of Stay vs X-Ray", x = "X-Ray", y = "Length of Stay")

ggplot(data = mydata, aes(x = facility, y = length)) +
  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = b0.facility, slope = b1.facility, lwd = 1, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Length of Stay vs Facility", x = "Facility", y = "Length of Stay")
```


### Sorting by R^2

```{r}
summary(infection.model)$r.squared
summary(census.model)$r.squared
summary(xray.model)$r.squared
summary(facility.model)$r.squared
```
